interruption.what: the OpenAI account ran out of credit; the API refused the next request with HTTP 429 insufficient_quota (credit_balance_exhausted)
interruption.executor_response: quota errors are not retried; the run stopped and wrote stop_20261123T215525348816Z.json (108 replies, integrity valid)
interruption.resume: after the owner added credit and authorised it, the same run was resumed in place with VISUALDOC_E6_RESUME_DIR from the same commit and notebook code (second session record); only the 130 missing items were sent; mmlb-1057 A was sent as its second attempt (the refused one counts as the first), every other reply is a first attempt
interruption.effect_on_the_design: the pause fell between pairs 53 and 54 (the refused call was the first of pair 54), so every A/V pair stayed adjacent; the plan, order, requests, budget guard and cumulative ceiling were unchanged

20261123T200722253880Z_d94e85f1_full.backends: fp_8b385e4fac served 221 replies; fp_b4fe8e4fe2 served the first 17 after the resume (execution 109-125, 22:39-22:55 UTC): 8 complete pairs and the first call of pair 62, 8 in A and 9 in V. Both arms met both backends in near-equal numbers; adjacent pairing keeps any backend effect within pairs. The smoke run used fp_8b385e4fac.

spend.price_basis: OpenAI list price, USD 0.15 / 0.60 per 1M input / output tokens; cached input is billed lower, so the bound is conservative

evaluation.by: notebook 05 section 7 (cell e6-evaluate) on the frozen full run; validation 16/16; outputs equal tables/evaluation_summary.json and tables/per_question.csv byte for byte
evaluation.primary: A 25/102, V 38/102, delta +0.127, 13 fixed / 0 broken, cluster 95 % [0.074, 0.193], one-sided sign-flip p 2^-10

added_after_the_runs.notebook 05: markdown cells e6-title, e6-eval-md, e6-interpretation (status and results), and code cell e6-evaluate (defaults to this frozen run, verifies SHA256SUMS, re-derives the tables, asserts the regression references). No cell that builds, sends, parses, scores or analyses requests changed (AUDIT.json).

audit.script: standalone, kept outside the repository (AGENTS.md: no new modules for experimental work)
audit.limitation: 9 of the 14 held-out PDFs were offloaded to iCloud and unreadable at audit time; for them the page images were checked against the frozen E5 render manifest (SHA-256), not re-rendered. The application re-rendered the other 169 pages byte for byte.

not_verifiable_here: whether the model would give the same replies today (one replicate at temperature 0; run-to-run variation not measured in E6)
OpenAI's billed amounts: costs are list price from the returned token counts, with no cached-input discount
whether ColQwen2 saw held-out documents in training
the indexing latencies, which come from E5 on one machine and were not re-measured
